chunks.text:
## 2026-09-17 V15.3.33 async/navigation performance pass
- Removed the unconditional `await Task.Yield()` at the start of section navigation; this removed roughly one UI frame (~18-21 ms in prior NAV_PHASE logs) from each section switch.
- Added a low-memory fast path in MemoryPressureService so navigation does not request GC memory-load data when working set is below the pressure threshold.
- Removed a redundant `Task.Run` wrapper around the already-async/cached Network Analyzer readback.
- Hardened unguarded async UI event handlers (main navigation, subsection navigation, Optimization Plan button and styled dialog action button) through SafeTaskService.Forget so exceptions are observed/logged instead of surfacing as unhandled async-event crashes.
- Deadlock audit: no `.Wait()`, `GetAwaiter().GetResult()` or explicit `async void` in active code; remaining async event handlers have local try/catch. The single `.Result` use is guarded by `IsCompletedSuccessfully`.
- Idle baseline stayed very low (~0.013% normalized CPU over 15 s; working set about +1 MB; no handle growth).
- Build profiling confirmed WinUI/XAML is the main compile cost: MarkupCompilePass2 ~6.5 s, CoreCompile ~2.55 s, XamlPreCompile ~2.09 s.

chunks.heading: ## V15.4.56 — dirty-state refresh coalescing
chunks.text:
## V15.4.56 — dirty-state refresh coalescing
- Navázáno na V15.4.55 active navigation no-op guards.
- Ověřen plánovaný same-target in-flight dedupe: WatchdogService volá navigation work synchronně a ShowSectionCoreAsync nastaví _section ještě před prvním skutečným await/yield, takže okno "stejný user target in-flight, ale _section ještě stará" v aktuální architektuře prakticky nevzniká. Další pending-navigation vrstva nebyla přidána.
- Nalezen skutečný UI hot-path: Tweak_PropertyChanged -> QueueDirtyStateRefresh na UI threadu dříve bypassoval queue a okamžitě volal UpdateDirtyState(), takže burst Current/Pending/IsLoaded změn mohl opakovaně skenovat celý _tweaks seznam.
- QueueDirtyStateRefresh nyní vždy používá jediný dispatcher queue slot bez ohledu na thread; burst změn se coalescuje na max 1 UpdateDirtyState za dispatcher tick.
- Classic ToggleSwitch callback nyní používá QueueDirtyStateRefresh místo přímého UpdateDirtyState.
- Virtual TweakVirtualRowViewModel callback nyní používá QueueDirtyStateRefresh místo přímého UpdateDirtyState.
- ApplyClickCoreAsync a Discard_Click po RefreshCards používají QueueDirtyStateRefresh, takže nepřidávají další okamžitý full-scan.
- Přidán RunDirtyRefreshCoalescingSmokeAsync a full-smoke gate:
  - 1000 QueueDirtyStateRefresh požadavků musí vytvořit právě jeden pending dispatcher refresh,
  - po yield/drain se _dirtyRefreshQueued vrátí na 0.

chunks.text:
## 2026-09-20 - V15.4.121 native backend cleanup + single-flight race hardening + faster Core builds
- Removed the last PowerShell fallback from MTU apply/read-back. MtuOptimizerService now reads the original adapter through .NET NetworkInterface and verifies IPv4/optional IPv6 with bounded 80/180/350/700 ms retries after netsh apply.
- MTU smoke stayed green on the active Ethernet adapter (IPv4 MTU 1492); full state-accuracy and non-tweak mutation audits remained clean.

## 2026-09-21 - V15.4.150 transaction safety, drift watchdog, hardened process runner, startup inventory V2
- Continued from V15.4.149 and integrated the high-value architecture ideas selected from pc-tweaker-app without changing the app's visual design.
- Added durable write-ahead tweak transactions before the first mutation in TweakEngine.
- Transactions are marked Committed after verified apply, RolledBack after failed/cancelled apply, and persisted under ProgramData.
- Added delayed startup recovery for interrupted Pending transactions so a crash/power loss between Begin and Commit can restore previous values.
- Added Windows-build-triggered tweak drift watchdog. It checks only recently applied, non-restored tweak items instead of rescanning the whole catalog on every startup.
- Drift report is persisted locally and now shown in Windows Update Center as TWEAK DRIFT with verified/drifted counts and up to 6 changed tweak names.

chunks.text:
## DEV 15.4.363 — reversible tweaks + cleaner scan + GPU compatibility + data-driven registry
- Implemented the Sparkle-inspired pieces as native .NET/WinUI architecture, without importing Electron/GPL source.
- Reversible tweak model formalized: TweakDefinition now exposes RevertAsync/CanRestoreOriginal/RevertMode; registry tweaks restore the exact original registry value through RegistryBackupStore, while ordinary boolean command tweaks remain reversible through SetAsync(previous). IOptimizerModule now exposes original-value restore and TweakEngine has an exclusive RestoreOriginalAsync path with verify/read-back + OperationJournal entries.
- Existing transactional apply/rollback/history infrastructure remains the core: atomic registry snapshot, write-ahead transaction, read-back verification, TweakBatchHistory per-batch undo and OperationJournal. The new original-value revert path complements rather than duplicates it.
- Data-driven tweak registry: CatalogService routing is now backed by TweakCatalogSource descriptors + indexed factories instead of a section switch. TweakBatchHistory resolver consumes the same registry, removing its duplicated hardcoded source list.
- Cleaner upgraded from one aggregate Temp-only scan to real category scanning: User Temp, Direct3D shader cache, NVIDIA DX/GL cache and AMD DxCache are measured independently and in parallel. Storage UI now shows measured MB per category with selectable checkboxes, cleans only selected categories, then rescans and reports actual freed/remaining bytes + failed locked files.
- Fixed old mismatch where the Storage cleaner text claimed shader caches but GetSafeCleanupSize/ClearSafeCaches only covered Temp; safe cleanup now genuinely includes all listed shader cache paths.
- GPU compatibility detection expanded to gpu:any / gpu:nvidia / gpu:amd / gpu:intel plus legacy nvidia/amd/intel scopes, with explicit detected-vendor reason text when unsupported. NVIDIA telemetry remains NVIDIA-scoped; Intel telemetry is now Intel-scoped instead of being offered on every machine.
- Driver-start tweaks were upgraded to exact original-value revert too, so every registry-backed tweak audited by the catalog now has original-value restore metadata.
- V14 audit smoke extended to gate the new architecture: data-driven registry size, original-value revert coverage for registry tweaks, NVIDIA/Intel scope metadata and Cleaner category/total consistency.
